# Three.js 0.185.1 vendored browser module

This directory contains the unmodified `build/three.module.min.js`, its
`build/three.core.min.js` import, `LICENSE`, and `package.json` files from the
official npm package `three@0.185.1`. The
package is pinned only for Cartofreako's offline Stage 14 flat-plane browser
canary; Cartofreako does not wrap an interrupted atlas plate around a sphere.

- upstream: <https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js>
- npm package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.185.1>
